input.question: Tesla Motors, Why they are so great, Why I've never heard about them before, and why everyone isn't driving this supposed amazing car?
input.ground_truth: > Tesla Motors, Why they are so great, They sell a unique product that is considered very trendy. > Why I've never heard about them before, You don't go outside much, read newspapers very often, or trade stocks. Seriously, the name Tesla is everywhere on reddit, even. They are a young company though, so that might be part of the issue. > and why everyone isn't driving this supposed amazing car? Brand new high tech cars aren't cheap. You'd be lucky to pay less than 60 grand for even the most basic model. Also, many people have concerns about the battery range and recharging safety/convenience.

messages.content: You are a helpful AI assistant.

Explain the following question in a simple way as if you are explaining to a 5-year-old.

Question: Tesla Motors, Why they are so great, Why I've never heard about them before, and why everyone isn't driving this supposed amazing car?

Answer:

response.prediction:
Okay! Imagine Tesla is like a super cool, shiny toy car that can drive all by itself and doesn’t need to go to a gas station for fuel. It uses magic electricity instead of gas! That’s really neat because it’s quiet and doesn’t make the air yucky like gas cars do.

Now, why haven’t you heard about them before? Well, sometimes grown-ups don’t hear about new things right away. Tesla cars are newer and a little bit more expensive, like how some really cool toys cost more than others. Also, not everyone has a place to charge them because they need special plugs, not just gas stations.

And why isn’t everyone driving a Tesla? Well, some people can’t afford them yet because they’re pricey. Some people are used to the old way of cars with gas. Also, not every city has enough places to plug in and charge a Tesla, so it’s harder for some people to use them.

But Tesla cars are really cool and lots of people think they’re great because they’re fast, quiet, and help keep the air clean! Maybe in the future, more people will have them.
